name: Standing Quad Stretch
steps: Stand tall beside a wall or sturdy chair, placing one hand lightly on it for balance, and shift your weight onto your inside leg.
Bend your opposite knee to bring your heel up behind you and grasp your ankle or the top of your foot with your free hand.
Keep your knees close, gently tuck your pelvis and draw your heel toward your hip until the front of your thigh stretches.
Hold the stretch steadily with relaxed breathing on one leg, then release gently and switch sides.
tips: Keep your standing knee slightly soft and avoid arching your lower back forward.
Keep your bent knee pointing straight toward the floor rather than drifting out to the side.
